FAQ

Food wrapping paper FAQ

Which food wrapping paper formats are available?

The planned range includes greaseproof paper, burger wrapping paper, wax paper and butcher paper in sheet, roll, printed, interfolded or private-label formats where applicable. The exact construction and supply format are confirmed for each inquiry.

Can food wrapping paper use custom printing?

Custom printing can be discussed for greaseproof, burger wrapping, wax and butcher paper projects. Artwork, colors, paper grade, ink system, odor expectations and destination-market documents are reviewed before approval.

Are PFAS-free options available?

PFAS-free material options can be discussed for applicable constructions. The intended claim and evidence must be matched to the selected paper, coating, print system and finished product.

Is wax paper suitable for oven baking?

Wax paper is generally intended for wrapping, handling and separation. It should not replace baking parchment in direct high-temperature oven use unless the selected specification is explicitly confirmed for that application.

Are all butcher paper colors and performance claims confirmed?

No. Color, grammage, wet strength, coating, direct food contact, freezer, heat and BBQ suitability must be verified before a product specification or claim is approved.
